test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1st December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. "Hittch."

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The correct spelling is 'Hitch.'
 
• 'Hitch' means to get a free ride in someone else's vehicle as a way of travelling.
 
• Example:
 
 
• ​*Naina could hardly wait to hitch it up and take a ride on her way to Shimla.​*
 
 
 
• Therefore, 'Hitch' is incorrectly spelt among the given options.
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's know the meaning of the other options:
